title: Open 11.1
creator: CrossFit Games
description: Ten-minute AMRAP of 30 double-unders and 15 power snatches at 75/55 lb. The very first Open workout: a light barbell, a jump rope and lungs. Scale by dropping to single-unders or a lighter bar; the workout was repeated as 14.1.
